facts.fact: 最后一个刺客尖叫着倒下，倒在阿拉里克·奥西纳斯特脚下的玻璃与玫瑰之海中。
facts.anchor: the last assassin collapsed with a scream, joining his hapless comrades in the still sea of glass and roses at Alaric Ossinast’s feet.

facts.fact: 阿拉里克没意识到自己杀的是最后一个刺客。
facts.anchor: Alaric didn’t realize he was the last.

facts.fact: 埃拉格比亲王一向是田园式享乐与健康的化身。
facts.anchor: Prince Elagbi had always been the picture of bucolic frivolity and good health

facts.fact: 塞夫雷姆说：「你在吼叫。你从不吼叫。」
facts.anchor: You’re shouting,” said the legionnaire. “You never shout.

facts.fact: 卡特塔杜克的达雅·朗索妮娜雅玛曾把内纳瓦伦继承人的求婚带给阿拉里克。
facts.anchor: Niamha, the Daya of Catanduc, who had once upon a time delivered the offer of marriage with the Nenavarene heir to Alaric

facts.fact: 苏拉克威尔正在查看靠在枕头上的娜雅玛。
facts.anchor: Surakwel was inspecting Niamha as she sat propped up against pillows

facts.fact: 苏拉克威尔说他提早离开化装舞会，因为他显然不想让阿拉里克在场。
facts.anchor: I left the masquerade early because you clearly did not want me there

facts.fact: 塔拉辛的飞行艇发来一串以太波坐标，指向丝之群岛。
facts.anchor: They received a string of coordinates on the aetherwave—from Mistress Ileis’s coracle, pointing to the Silklands.

facts.fact: 阿拉里克说温普克已经死了。
facts.anchor: Wempuq is dead,” Alaric said curtly.

facts.fact: 丝之群岛的统治权已传到他的女儿奥里雅尔手中。
facts.anchor: control of the Silklands has now passed to his daughter, Oryal.

facts.fact: 娜雅玛建议先问乌尔杜贾女王该怎么办。
facts.anchor: We should ask Queen Urduja what is to be done

facts.fact: 若阿伦西娜·伊夫拉利斯今日死去，内纳瓦伦领地将被焚尽，无人生还。
facts.anchor: if Alunsina Ivralis dies today, the Nenavar Dominion will burn. And there will be no survivors.
